scope: Handover section 3: parameter interaction, undo host gestures, engine voice monitor, sixteen-voice UI ownership
truth: Host parameter listeners, audio-thread Engine::VoiceInfo/RankInfo, and the existing tagged keyboard event protocol; no hardware measurement or audio model is introduced.

interaction.edits: Exactly one balanced begin/end host gesture for each changed parameter; a context-menu pointer action must not also activate the underlying control.
interaction.pure: MIDI learn cannot be armed or applied in PURE CS-80; existing mappings remain stored.
interaction.retargeting: A memory miniature targets its own memory parameter; rank/tone controls target the currently represented host parameter.

undo.changed_parameters: Each parameter actually changed by undo or redo receives one begin followed by its value callbacks followed by one end.
undo.unchanged_parameters: No host gesture is sent for a parameter not changed by the transaction.
undo.history: Replay adds no undo transaction and leaves unrelated automated parameters unchanged.

monitor.equality: Published values exactly equal the corresponding read-only engine taps at the end of the last processBlock; no UI read accesses mutable engine state.
monitor.visibility: The drawer identifies the monitored voice and rank and labels traces as engine control taps rather than a measured transfer response.
monitor.neutrality: Enabling monitor publication leaves rendered samples exactly unchanged.
monitor.keyboard_order: Exactly four focus stops: channel I, channel II, CLOSE, then the new Monitored physical voice selector. All four retain the existing minimum target-size gate.
monitor.selection_update: On opening or refreshing a published frame, the physical-voice selector has exactly the frame capacity (8 or 16) choices and shows the selected slot immediately, including when no further audio block arrives.

sixteen_voice.meter: Sixteen allocated voices publish count 16 and bits 0..15, with extension voices in bits 8..15. Leaving the mode clears extension bits.
sixteen_voice.pressure: A tagged UI key allocated to the second engine accepts its own pressure; reassignment or host takeover revokes the token. The first eight voices retain existing behavior.
sixteen_voice.pure: PURE CS-80 remains eight voices and publishes no extension activity.

mutation_gate: Deliberately remove each behavior category (binding, host replay gestures, engine-tap publication, extension publication, extension pressure ownership) and require the corresponding new regression to fail, then restore.
